breaking.change: A font has no atlas of its own any more (every glyph is rastered from its file at the size it is drawn), so FontInfo no longer reports one. It reports the face instead: family, weight (its OS/2 weight class) and axes (its variation axes' tags). ascender, descender, lineHeight, icons and pixel are unchanged.
breaking.fix: Read family, weight or axes; a game that sized text from emPx or pxRange sets TextDesc.size or a CSS font-size in px instead.

breaking.change: The cook keeps a font's file whole and lays text out from it, so the number of glyphs cooked into a font is no longer a cost: the budget is gone and project.ogt refuses it as an unknown budget. og cook --report's font entry gives glyphs (the file's), fileBytes and icons.
breaking.fix: Delete the fontGlyphs line from project.ogt's budgets block; a font's size shows under budgets.assetBytes.
